Jumped Ok sat 4-5l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, ran on well took over 50m and drew clear late # all honours

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 14 lengths. got up fence turn 8 lengths. ran on well # too far back

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (3.5L from lead). Back 1 length & in 3 Wide midrace until pushed to quicken 3 @ 550m. Chasing Four Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Six Wide in straight. # Wide & struggled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners at the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). In Two Wide & back 1 length midrace until pushed to quicken @ 600m. Chasing Two Wide @ 500m & pressured Two Wide @ 400m. Back to rail (4L from lead) on home turn. Chased steadily on inside in straight. # Sound effort.
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. battled away # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was bumped lost ground. Then was shifted in behind runners from its barrier.

Rider could offer no explanation for the poor performance. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer was advised a warning would now be placed on record due to the poor performance (Beaten 19L).
